Andhra Pradesh.contentHtml:
Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences (SVIMS) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 3 Chief Security Officer, Security Officer Posts. This recruitment drive offers a great opportunity for candidates looking for government jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can download the application form from the official website and submit it offline.The offline application process is open until 20-03-2026, and candidates are advised to send their completed applications well before the deadline. In this article, you will find complete details about Chief Security Officer, Security Officer Recruitment 2026, including vacancy details, eligibility criteria, age limit, salary, selection process, application steps, and important links.

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences (SVIMS)
Post Name Chief Security Officer / Security Officer
No of Posts 3
Salary Rs.38,000/- - Rs.54,000/- Per Month
Qualification Degree from a recognized university.
Age Limit Max: 50 years
Last Date 20 March 2026
Apply Mode Offline
Job Type Ad-hoc

SVIMS Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF

Candidates should download and read the SVIMS Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below.

Download SVIMS Job 2026 Notification PDF

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts
Chief Security Officer 1
Security Officer 2
Total 3
Trending Govt Jobs
  • RBI 650 Assistant Online Form 2026
  • IDBI Bank Junior Assistant Manager Online Form 2026
  • Indian Army Agniveer Recruitment Rally Notification 2026
  • AIIMS NORCET 10 Online Form 2026
  • HPCL 731 Engineers, JEA and More Online Form 2026

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

  • Chief Security Officer: (i) Degree from a recognized university (ii) Meritorious Ex-Army personnel equivalent to or more than CI cadre of A.P Police Department. Desirable: Height 170cms, Chest 81cms (85cms expanded), sound health, Vision 6/12 without glasses, no colour blindness, fitness certificate.
  • Security Officer: (i) Degree from a recognized university (ii) Served in Indian Army as Subedar/JCO or equivalent rank. Desirable: Height 170cms, Chest 81cms (85cms expanded), sound health, Vision 6/12 without glasses, no colour blindness, fitness certificate.

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Category Fee
General/OBC Nil
SC/ST Nil

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

  • Maximum Age Limit: 50 years for all posts.
  • Age relaxation of 5 years for reserved category candidates for the Security Officer post.

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend

  • Chief Security Officer: Rs. 54,000/- Per Month
  • Security Officer: Rs.38,000/- Per Month

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates

Event Date
Last date for submission of Application 20 March 2026

SVIMS Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  • Interview

How to Apply

Candidates who wish to apply for SVIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.

  • Read the official notification carefully before applying.
  • Download the application form from the official website: https://svimstpt.ap.nic.in.
  • Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
  • Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
  • Check all details carefully before submission.
  • Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
  • Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-03-2026.
  • Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.
